content.title: Film Recommendations
content.body:
## Overview

These films offer profound storytelling and thematic depth. Consider scheduling a movie night to explore these narratives.

## Recommended Films

- **Everything Everywhere All at Once** - Mind-bending multiverse narrative with surprising emotional depth.
- **Parasite** - Bong Joon-ho's masterpiece with genre-shifting brilliance and sharp social commentary.
- **Arrival** - Thoughtful sci-fi focusing on language and communication rather than typical alien invasion themes.
